scientific_integrity: Analytic asymptotic argument from exact inverse-branch series, controlled Abel expansion and Euler-Maclaurin. Finite symbolic and numerical diagnostics do not certify an infinite conclusion.
scientific_limitations: Fixed standard LSV maps with parameters strictly between zero and one; no uniform endpoint parameter bounds; the derivative coefficient can vanish and an equivalent historical local expansion is a residual originality risk.
title: Subprincipal density asymptotics at an intermittent neutral fixed point
